[5] Procedures performed included drainage of Left Axilla, Open Approach, Diagnostic; resection of Right Kidney, Percutaneous Endoscopic Approach; performance of Urinary Filtration, Intermittent, Less than 6 Hours Per Day.
[6] Medications administered included Doxercalciferol 6mcg IV, Iso-Osmotic Dextrose 50mL IV, CeFAZolin 2g IV, Sodium Chloride 0.9% Flush 3-10mL IV, Senna 17.2mg PO/NG, Pantoprazole 40mg PO, 0.9% Sodium Chloride 100mL IV, Sodium Chloride 0.9% 1000mL IV, Warfarin 5mg PO/NG, Lidocaine 1% 1mL ID, Clindamycin 1% Solution 1Appl TP, Vial 1VIAL IV, CefTRIAXone 2gm IV, sevelamer CARBONATE 2400mg PO, Acetaminophen 1000mg PO/NG, Vancomycin 1000mg IV, Bag 1BAG IV, MetroNIDAZOLE 500mg PO/NG, Polyethylene Glycol 17g PO/NG, Iso-Osmotic Sodium Chloride 1BAG IV, Calcium Gluconate 2g IV, OxyCODONE (Immediate Release) 5mg PO/NG, Docusate Sodium 100mg PO/NG, Clindamycin 600mg IV, Apixaban 2.5mg PO/NG, Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate 30gm PO/NG, Dorzolamide 2%/Timolol 0.5% Ophth. 1DROP LEFT EYE, PrednisoLONE Acetate 1% Ophth. Susp. 1DROP LEFT EYE, amLODIPine 15mg PO/NG, Ramelteon 8mg PO/NG, Sarna Lotion 1Appl TP, and Atorvastatin 80mg PO/NG.
[7] Microbiology results were negative.
[8] Services provided included MED.
[9] The patient was admitted to the Emergency Department, Medicine, PACU, and Surgery/Vascular/Intermediate wards.
